## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
`select_failures` should be fixed before merge because it drops dot-prefixed report paths that the other selectors match, so failed tests are silently left out of the selection.

## Changes
The pull request adds `select_failures`, which picks requested paths from a runner report's `failed` list. It also refactors `select_cached` and `_select_normalized` with no change in behaviour and adds `tests/test_selection.py`, which covers all three selectors.

## Critical
(none)

## Important
- app/selection.py:20 — correctness — Match failure-report paths with `normalize(path)` — If the report has `"failed": ["./tests/test_x.py"]` and `requested` is `{"tests/test_x.py"}`, the function returns `[]`, because it compares the raw path. `select_explicit` at `app/selection.py:6` normalizes before it compares and still returns the original spelling, which is the behaviour the docstring describes. — When a runner reports `./`-prefixed paths, requested failed tests are silently skipped on re-run. — Fix: Use `[path for path in report["failed"] if normalize(path) in requested]` and add a dot-prefixed case to `test_failure_report_selection`.
